checklist.item: Queries: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for every query on the request path and at startup; flag every SCAN and every USE TEMP B-TREE over results
checklist.evidence: A bun:sqlite preload (prepare/query/run/exec) recorded every SQL text and call site while `bun test --preload capture.ts` ran the suite (exit 0, 928 pass, 100 files). The capture reached all 131 db.prepare/query/run/exec call sites of src/*.ts outside tests. `bun explain.ts capture.jsonl <1x seed> explain.json` (exit 0) ran EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on the 162 distinct DML statements; 72 have SCAN or USE TEMP B-TREE. Every request-path read of results is a SEARCH on results_by_check or results_by_sample. Temporary B-trees over results: locationTally (src/service.ts:638, GROUP BY location, today on every uncached GET /checks/:id/location-uptime: finding 1), dailyUptime (src/service.ts:604, GROUP BY day) and dayLatencies (src/service.ts:647, ORDER BY latency_ms) for closed days without a stored row, after each UTC midnight (finding 2). Full scans on the request path: incidents in all 7 listIncidents variants (src/service.ts:1458, plus TEMP B-TREE, finding 4) and audit_log for filtered GET /admin/audit (src/audit-log.ts:125, note). The other scans touch small or bounded tables (checks, tokens, definitions, manual_incidents, resend_commands capped at 1000), run at startup or on config load (NEWEST_PER_LOCATION_SQL src/service.ts:681, openInactive src/service.ts:561), in hourly retention of the rollup tables, only in a migration (src/db.ts:108, 138) or in the backup command (src/backup.ts:165).

checklist.item: Startup: a CPU profile of the startup (bun --cpu-prof), with the top functions by self time
checklist.evidence: Nightly startup_cpu_ms B 250 ms (A 250), budget 325: ok. Local CPU at the first /readyz 200 without a profiler: 1x round medians 110-120 ms (4 rounds x 10 starts), 10x 120 ms (3 starts): it does not grow with the data. `bun prof.ts` (bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-interval=100, SIGTERM at ready, 3 runs per size, exit 0): CPU at ready 140-150 ms at 1x and 10x. Top self time at 1x over 3 runs (332.8 ms sampled): native root 67.7 ms (20.3 %), DurationFormat under pulse-kit format-duration.js:2 47.6 ms (14.3 %), pulse-kit address-guard.js module 23.7 ms (7.1 %), node:net Socket 10.3 ms, zod schema code 10.1 ms, zod runChecks 7.8 ms, push under src/config.ts:356 7.7 ms. No SQL and no src/ function over 1 %. Two A/Bs with 10 starts x 2 rounds per side (a lazy DurationFormat: means 118/115 against 120/116 ms; the kit barrel cut to the used modules: 115/116 against 116/116 ms) show no difference, so the DurationFormat weight is a profiler artifact. No finding.

checklist.item: Costs that grow with data: the repository's bench, or a local A/B with a larger data set; how each measured cost changes with the data size
checklist.evidence: Nightly 45394568321: every api row within budget, including cold_* on the 10x seed and eod_* with 518,400 rows of today. Local, without Docker: `bun bench/eod-read.ts --api .` (2 runs, exit 0) p95 1-3 ms per route, eod_read_cpu_ms 340 and 300. `bun bench/cold-read.ts --api . --density 10 --today-rows 288000` (1 run, exit 0) cold_get_checks_ms 48, cold_read_cpu_ms 50, but the ungated warm start on a file without stored day tallies took 1852 and 1828 ms. `bun grow.ts` (exit 0): GET /checks/c0/location-uptime after an ingest 0.5 -> 12.7 ms for 1,077 -> 26,997 rows of today (finding 1). The first reads with yesterday's day rows missing (state after UTC midnight): /checks 7.5-10.7 -> 246.8-249.7 ms and /latency 11.6-14.7 -> 329.8-334.5 ms, read CPU 40-60 -> 630-640 ms (finding 2). GET /incidents?status=resolved 0.2 -> 5.9 -> 53.2 ms for 0 -> 10k -> 100k incidents (finding 4). No growth for /checks, /uptime, /latency, /checks/:id/latency, /components, /components/uptime after an ingest, startup CPU, or POST /results.

checklist.item: Memory over time: RSS after N minutes of steady load, against the RSS at the start
checklist.evidence: `timeout 540 bun mem.ts <api> <dir> <1x seed> 5`, exit 0. N = 5 min open loop per second: 30 POST /results, 10 GET /checks, 1 each of /uptime, /latency, /checks/:id/latency, /components, /components/uptime, /checks/:id/location-uptime. 13,792 requests, 0 failed. RSS at the start 72.3 MiB (65.5 at ready); under load 90.1-94.3 MiB with no upward trend, 91.7 MiB at the end, 86.5 MiB 30 s after. VmHWM 101.9 MiB. CPU 1.98 s per minute. Budgets idle_rss_mib 88 and peak_rss_mib 115: ok. No finding.

checklist.item: Tests: CPU time per test file; name the slowest files
checklist.evidence: `/usr/bin/time bun test` x3, exit 0, 928 pass: CPU 7.11, 7.00, 7.04 s against test_cpu_s 9.2 s (nightly B 7.25 s). Per file (`bun test <file>`, 3 passes, 100 files): 86 exit 1 only from the 80 % coverage threshold on a one-file run, 0 failing tests.
